positions.name: ProductIdentityChannelDisambiguation
positions.frame: How does core product identity distinguish curated expertise installation from communication and distribution channels?
positions.why: Disentangles the foundational definition of the product (curated expertise installation) from the phone number / SMS channel, which was mistakenly elevated to a global identity tagline through exploratory experiments.

positions.name: SmsChannelTierPackaging
positions.frame: How should high-overhead distribution channels like SMS be mapped to commercial tiers and enterprise packaging?
positions.why: Balances the high operational and verification costs of individual SMS provisioning against commercial packaging, weighing an enterprise-only restriction against an opt-in upsell while explicitly holding the decision in an undecided epistemic state.

positions.name: SubgraphScopingTemporalityOntology
positions.frame: How can extraction architectures isolate exploratory experiment claims from root product definitions to prevent narrative drift?
positions.why: Identifies architectural and ontological gaps in the extraction pipeline—specifically temporality classification and subgraph segmentation—that cause local experimental positioning to contaminate global worldview.

attaches.why: Continues the evaluation of channel-dependent trust dynamics, contrasting the authentic texture of SMS in high-trust contexts with the spam friction and operational verification burden in skeptical or evaluator contexts.
Connects user archetype classification to channel suitability, noting how technical and trust barriers manifest specifically across the Knowledge-Rich Consumer persona.
